bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH SUNDAY EVENING... Combined seas 10 to 12 ft, building to 15 to 17 ft this evening, then building to 18 to 22 ft late tonight into early Sunday. Bar conditions rough, becoming severe tonight with breakers covering the bar. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 300 PM Saturday, 330 AM Sunday, and 345 PM Sunday. The afternoon ebbs on Saturday and Sunday will be strong.
